description: This is a Python source file implementing a backend subtitle generation service that leverages whisperx for automatic speech recognition and the M2M100 model for translation. It provides a main interface function 'generate_subtitle' to transcribe and optionally translate videos, outputting subtitle files in 'srt' or 'vtt' formats.

methods.name: str generate_subtitle(video_path: str, subtitle_lang: str, format: str)
methods.description: Main function to generate subtitles for a video, transcribing audio and translating if needed.

methods.name: str _normalize_lang_code(lang: str)
methods.description: Normalizes language code to lowercase trimmed string.

methods.name: str _ensure_supported_format(fmt: str)
methods.description: Ensures the subtitle format is either 'srt' or 'vtt'.

methods.name: str _determine_output_path_with_subtitle_suffix(video_path: str, fmt: str)
methods.description: Constructs output subtitle filename based on input video filename and format.

methods.name: str _format_ts_srt(seconds: float)
methods.description: Formats timestamp in seconds to SRT timestamp format.

methods.name: str _format_ts_vtt(seconds: float)
methods.description: Formats timestamp in seconds to VTT timestamp format.

methods.name: str _format_segments_as_srt(segments: List[Dict])
methods.description: Converts transcript segments into SRT subtitle string.

methods.name: str _format_segments_as_vtt(segments: List[Dict])
methods.description: Converts transcript segments into VTT subtitle string.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict],str] _transcribe_with_whisperx(video_path: str)
methods.description: Performs speech-to-text transcription using whisperx, with alignment and language detection.

methods.name: List[Dict] _translate_segments_with_m2m100_local( segments: List[Dict], source_lang: str, target_lang: str, )
methods.description: Translates transcript segments using a local M2M100 model, or simulates translation if model not available.

ctags.signature: ( segments: List[Dict], source_lang: str, target_lang: str, )
